#### [One platform for Limitless Connection](https://www.qualcommventures.com/insights/blog/zoom-ipo-how-a-unique-founder-and-customer-focus-led-to-techs-biggest-ipo-of-the-year/)

The cloud meeting company, unifies cloud video conferencing, simple online meetings, and group chat into one easy-to-use platform. Zoom’s solution offers the best video, audio, and screen-sharing experience.

Zoom (NYSE: ZM) went IPO on April 18, 2019
